description: Outputs of the Solana leader-ordering measurement. Judges re-fetch any block with getBlock(slot, {encoding: jsonParsed, maxSupportedTransactionVersion: 1, transactionDetails: full, rewards: false, commitment: confirmed}) and match memos that start with ib|1| or signatures from sent_transactions.jsonl. Lamports are integers. SOL strings are 9 decimal places. entry_index is null when getBlock does not provide entry boundaries. manifest.json, run_summary.json, and planned_transactions.* in this directory are the deterministic offline fixture (experiment_id e1071-test). mainnet_dry_run_manifest.json and mainnet_dry_run_summary.json are one post-Alpenglow mainnet dry-run and are not a golden test vector.

manifest.json.alpenglow.regime: after or before. A successful measurement is after.
manifest.json.spend.planned_fee_lamports: Sum of estimated fees for the unsigned plan.
manifest.json.targets[]: identity, client_id, client_family, version, tpu_quic, assigned_windows

files.sent_transactions.jsonl: Live only. signature, seq, slot_sent_at, planned_slot, path, destination, sent, signed, error, fee_lamports.
files.block_observations.jsonl: One row per planned transaction plus any unmatched ib|1| memo. landed, slot, block_index, entry_index, signature, fee_lamports, cu_price_set, cu_limit_set, cu_consumed, execution_err, memo.
files.block_observations.csv: Same rows as the observations JSONL. Empty cell means null.
files.block_context.jsonl: One row per fetched block: slot, tx_count, our_tx_count, entry_index_available, transactions[]. Each transaction has block_index, signature, fee_lamports, cu_price_micro_lamports, cu_limit, is_ours.
files.hypothesis_agreement.json: Pairwise agree/pairs/rate for each pre-registered rank field. rate is null when pairs is 0.
